mentions.name: gangway.sh
mentions.description: A self-hostable, Apache 2-licensed tool for quickly deploying small sites and apps, with an interface ergonomically similar to Claude artifacts for open source harnesses. It is designed to be easily forkable and kept in active development.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a quick way to deploy small sites and apps for clients and friends.
mentions.audience: Developers deploying small sites and apps for clients and friends
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on https://gangway.sh/

I always wanted to quickly deploy small sites and apps for clients and friends.
